node.title: M720 official norm-gate certificate soundness
node.statement: A complete official h=7..20 norm-gate payload, or a uniform nonvanishing theorem covering the same primitive norm-gate branch, soundly excludes all unpaid non-toral active cores in the official h=7..20 band once m720_official_paid_branch_alignment has reduced the problem to that branch.
node.attack_surface: formal certificate semantics and paid/norm-gate branch coverage
node.falsifier: a payload marked complete and zero for every primitive norm-gate case while an unpaid non-toral official h=7..20 active core survives
